description.narrative: The Digital for Development (D4D) Hub is a strategic platform established by the European Union and its Member States to work together as Team Europe to foster multi-stakeholder partnerships and boost investments to advance a human-centric digital transformation worldwide. Currently, 16 EU Member States are part of it2. ¿¿ The Digital for Development Hub (D4D Hub) has become increasingly relevant since its launch in December 2020. The geopolitical competition in the digital transformation sector is constantly intensifying, and partners countries are showing a growing interest in the human-centric digitalisation and in the EU Tech offer.¿¿  In this context, the EU and its Member States have committed to continuing their efforts under the Team Europe approach to establish a stronger, more strategic, coherent, and effective EU policy in global digital affairs. The new phase of the D4D Hub will facilitate this approach by ensuring coordination among its members and fostering human-centric green digital transformation in partner countries by promoting and scaling up investment and innovation.   The Hub will also facilitate policy dialogue with partner countries and help building strategic partnerships in a Team Europe approach. In doing so the Hub will strengthen its support to the EU and its Member State in implementing the multistakeholder and integrated approach at the basis of the EU Tech offer.¿¿It will support the EU in deepening on-going partnerships, broadening existing cooperation and connecting Team Europe actions for stronger impact.   The D4D Hub will engage the Private Sector, Civil Society Organizations (CSOs), and Academia and expands these memberships to build win-win multi-stakeholders¿ partnerships and investments with partner countries. Development Finance Institutions (DFIs) and Export Credit Agencies (ECAs) will be further involved in the activities of the D4D Hub to further promote strategic investments in Partner Countries.¿ This action aims at financing the secretariat of the D4D Hub to ensure its effective operationalisation and the achievement of its objectives, including promoting human-centric green digital transformation and shaping the EU Tech offer in Team Europe approach. ¿
